text:
A high school football player in Arkansas found a 2-foot-long cottonmouth snake inside his helmet last week.

The pit viper was so reluctant to exit the helmet that police officers had to pour water into it to force the snake out and into a bag.

毒蛇不愿意从头盔中出来，警察不得不将水倒入头盔中，将蛇推出并放入袋子中。
